description: Approval gate enforcement at Executor Step 5. Verifies gate fires only when both handler is configured and module declares requires_approval=true, and that all four result statuses map to the correct outcomes.

test_cases.description: Gate is skipped entirely when no ApprovalHandler is configured
Gate is skipped when handler is configured but module does not declare requires_approval=true
Gate fires and allows execution when handler returns approved
Gate fires and raises ApprovalDeniedError (APPROVAL_DENIED / HTTP 403) when handler returns rejected
Gate fires and raises ApprovalPendingError (APPROVAL_PENDING / HTTP 202) when handler returns pending with approval_id

driver_contract.no_http_status: This fixture used to declare `expected.http_status` (403 / 202) and no driver asserted it, because none can: no SDK exposes a mapping from an error code to an HTTP status, and that is deliberate. `protocol-spec.md` §7.5 and §8.2 annotate 47 framework codes with an `http_status`, but the MUST there is "define the following error TYPES" — the status is descriptive metadata for whoever puts an executor behind HTTP, not a required SDK surface. A conformance fixture may only declare what a driver can assert (apcore#94).
